note: java6-legacy round 1: javac 21 rejects the JDK 6 compiler <bootclasspath> (rt.jar) together with --release 21 (file-less compile failure of ledger-utils-comp) → drop the bootclasspath argument — L2 `compile|build|compilation failure: compilation failure` (24046cbfdd)
response:
<analysis>javac stops before compiling: "option --boot-class-path cannot be used together with --release". The JDK 6 build passes ${java.home}/lib/rt.jar as bootclasspath (maven-compiler-plugin compilerArguments); there is no rt.jar since JDK 9 and --release 21 already selects the platform API. The script removes the bootclasspath compiler argument (and an emptied <compilerArguments>) from every pom that sets it; nothing else changes.</analysis>
<script>
import re

ARGUMENTS = re.compile(r"\s*<compilerArguments>\s*<bootclasspath>[^<]*</bootclasspath>\s*</compilerArguments>")
SINGLE = re.compile(r"\s*<bootclasspath>[^<]*</bootclasspath>")
ARG_PAIR = re.compile(r"\s*<arg>\s*-(?:bootclasspath|-boot-class-path)\s*</arg>\s*<arg>[^<]*</arg>")


def fix(p):
    for path in p.files("**/pom.xml"):
        text = p.read(path)
        new = ARGUMENTS.sub("", text)
        new = SINGLE.sub("", new)
        new = ARG_PAIR.sub("", new)
        new = re.sub(r"\s*<compilerArguments>\s*</compilerArguments>", "", new)
        if new != text:
            p.write(path, new)
            p.log(f"{path}: bootclasspath compiler argument removed (--release 21 selects the platform API)")
</script>
